title: Ender Pearl Counter
description: A mod that counts the amount of pearls thrown by you and/or other players!
body:
A client-side Fabric mod that tracks how many Ender Pearls other players have thrown and displays the count next to their name above their head, using the actual Ender Pearl item texture as an icon.

> Ability to reset the pearl counter through commands + the Mod Settings (through Mod Menu)

### The Commands:
> /pearlcounter enable
> 
> /pearlcounter disable
> 
> /pearlcounter reset
> 
> *Can also use /pc instead of /pearlcounter!*
